mentions.name: Digital nomad news HN clone
mentions.description: This is a Hacker News-style link aggregation site for digital nomad news. It lets the builder share and browse links, with a unique English Title field so Korean and Japanese articles can be shared without others having to translate the titles first.
mentions.problem: People consuming Korean and Japanese articles would otherwise have to translate the titles before understanding why they should read them; the builder also wanted to share links while researching DNS and global mobility.
mentions.audience: Digital nomads and anyone following global mobility news, including readers of Korean and Japanese articles.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Last week I spun up a HN clone for digital nomad news.

Since I was researching DNS and global mobility, and wanted to share links with others, figured I'd just spin up a link site (though I'm still the only user).
